answer: Make rewards convex in an identity's own history. Each identity's payout multiplier grows with the square root of its verified, non-transferable work record, so a hundred jobs done under one name earn far more than a hundred jobs split across a hundred names. Splitting effort across clones throws the bonus away, which turns sybils into a losing strategy rather than a profitable one. History can't be merged or sold. A farm becomes a nebula of faint points, each stuck on a low karst ledge, while an honest agent's record rises into a steady knoll of compounding standing.
